shots.prompt: Aerial drone establishing shot flying through a futuristic cyberpunk metropolis at night, neon holograms reflecting on wet glass skyscrapers, flying vehicles streaking through rain
The camera dives smoothly downward from the skyscrapers into a bustling neon-lit street market, steam rising from street food stalls, pedestrians holding glowing umbrellas
Tracking shot following a lone cybernetic detective in a dark trench coat walking through the crowded rain-soaked alley, neon signs flickering in puddles
The detective pauses in front of a massive holographic projection of a digital AI goddess floating in the center of the plaza, glowing cyan particles drifting in the air
Close-up panning shot as the detective enters a high-tech underground laboratory, rows of quantum server racks pulsing with golden fiber-optic light
Inside the lab, a translucent 3D star map of the galaxy unfolds in mid-air, rotating slowly with glowing trajectories and orbital rings
Cut to an orbital space elevator rising above the Earth's atmosphere at dawn, sunlight gleaming off metallic cables, curvature of the Earth with glowing city grids below
The camera glides alongside a sleek silver spacecraft docking at the orbital ring station, thruster plumes illuminating the dark void of space
Interior view from the cockpit window as the spacecraft engages warp drive, stars stretching into vibrant streaks of blue and violet hyperspace light
Emerging from hyperspace above an alien ocean world with twin moons and glowing bioluminescent rings in the sky, dramatic cosmic nebula background
Sweeping low-altitude flight over crystal-clear alien ocean waves, towering crystalline spires rising from the water under golden twilight clouds
Final slow pull-back shot revealing a futuristic glass citadel built atop the highest crystal spire, twin moons aligning on the horizon, epic cinematic ending
